verdict.rationale: Notte documents a hosted, Bearer-authenticated HTTP API with an agent-start endpoint for running web AI agents on cloud browsers from natural-language tasks, so no local browser is needed. Functions can also be deployed and invoked as API endpoints. However, the evidence never shows how results come back: there is no status or polling endpoint and no registrable webhook callback, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented polling/status retrieval of agent results, registrable outbound webhooks for task completion, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the async API flow.
